body.summary: A computer-animated web series about a woman who puts on a VR headset and is trapped in a brightly coloured digital circus run by an AI ringmaster. The circus holds a small cast of humans who arrived the same way, all unable to leave and all slowly losing their grip on their memories and identities. Episodes are largely self-contained character studies inside the larger puzzle of escape, with the group's instability, the ringmaster's cheerful sadism and the question of what happens to a person who is 'abstracted' driving the arc. ||The series is ongoing; by the end of the first season the group has learned that abstraction is what awaits them and that the circus's creator may be a former human, with no confirmed exit found.||

characters.name: Pomni
relationships: wary alliance with Ragatha: the closest thing to a friend, offered as comfort she cannot quite accept
antagonised by Caine: he treats her distress as entertainment
uneasy bond with Jax: he needles her constantly

characters.name: Caine
descriptors: a floating set of teeth with eyeballs in a ringmaster's suit
relationships: creator and warden of the whole cast: he calls them his performers
fixated on Pomni as a new arrival to show off

characters.name: Ragatha
descriptors: rag doll with button eye and stitched body
relationships: protective of Pomni: offers reassurance and physical comfort

characters.name: Jax
relationships: torments Pomni and Gangle for amusement
odd camaraderie with Ragatha that he tests by pushing her limits

characters.name: Kinger
relationships: devoted to his wife Queenie, whose absence haunts him
treated as a joke by the others until his grief surfaces

characters.name: Zooble
relationships: quietly the most grounded voice in the group

characters.name: Gangle
descriptors: ribbon body with a comedy and a tragedy mask
relationships: her masks control her mood and are easily broken

characters.name: Queenie
relationships: married to Kinger: her abstraction is the wound at the centre of his character

settings: the Digital Circus, a candy-coloured endless tent with a central stage and corridors
the circus's living quarters and bedrooms
Caine's invented adventure zones, including a fast-food drive-through and a haunted mansion

arcs.summary: Pomni arrives, panics at the impossibility of leaving, and is walked through the circus's rules by the others while Caine stages a welcome adventure.
A trip to a haunted mansion turns into a test of the group's nerves, and Kinger's grief over Queenie surfaces.
Jax's cruelty toward Gangle escalates and the others' tolerance for him wears thin.
The group learns what abstraction is and that it is the fate waiting for any of them who break down.

motifs: the headset that traps the wearer
masks, especially Gangle's comedy and tragedy faces
doors and exits that lead nowhere
bright candy colours over body horror
themes: escapism and the cost of virtual worlds
grief and its erosion of the self
the indifference of a game master to players

notable_scenes.summary: Pomni wakes in the circus, sees a mirror, and cannot hold onto her own name.
Caine explains the rules of the circus with manic cheer while the others watch Pomni's horror.
The group's adventure in the haunted mansion, where Kinger's fear and grief take over.
Jax torments Gangle and breaks her comedy mask.
The cast confronts the reality of abstraction and what it does to a person.
